description: This file defines the TracingDispatcher class, which manages tracing operations within a browser context or network request context in the Playwright core server. It includes methods for starting, stopping, grouping, and handling tracing chunks, and interacts with external dispatchers and protocols.

classes.name: TracingDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class managing tracing operations, including start, stop, grouping, and chunk handling for tracing data.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing TracingDispatcher for a given scope and tracing object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new TracingDispatcher with a scope and tracing object.

methods.name: tracingGroup
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group with a name and location.

methods.name: tracingStopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current tracing chunk and returns artifact and entries.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the dispatcher is disposed, stopping ongoing tracing chunks if necessary.
